items.summary: HIP 7.17 (ROCm 10.2), MI300X: while a blocking stream is being captured, hipMallocAsync on any other, uncaptured stream returns hipErrorStreamCaptureUnsupported (900) for every capture mode, even with the thread's mode exchanged to relaxed; CUDA allows it. Warp 1.15's deterministic mode allocates its capture buffers that way; the port allocates them without the memory pool on HIP. Reproducer in warp-1.15 notes (session 1, relaxed.hip).

Thread block clusters (cluster_dim) on AMD GPUs that have them (gfx1250: hipLaunchAttributeClusterDimension, hipDeviceProp_t.clusterLaunch, runtime-only hipOccupancyMaxActiveClusters). warp-1.15 treats every AMD GPU as cluster-incapable by ruling Q2 (a): cluster_dim ignored, get_cuda_max_cluster_dim returns 1. Needs a gfx1250 host, a device-intrinsic replacement for the PTX %cluster_ctarank probe in test_cluster_dim, and the cluster launch through hipLaunchKernelExC.

A HIP branch in Warp's optional CMake build (CMakeLists.txt, tools/cmake/WarpDependencies.cmake), which compiles for NVIDIA GPUs and CPUs only. warp-1.15 stops its configure on ROCm-only hosts with a pointer to build_lib.py, by ruling Q4 (b). Revisit if upstream makes CMake the release build.

Feature request for ROCm/rocm-libraries (rocPRIM): radix_sort_keys/pairs (and hipCUB DeviceRadixSort) return hipErrorInvalidValue for floating-point keys with any bit range other than the full width (rocprim/device/device_radix_sort.hpp:796-799, ROCm 10.2), where CUB sorts the keys' radix encoding over the range. warp-1.15 works around it in sort.cu (encode, unsigned sort, decode). Draft in warp-1.15 notes, round 3; to be shown to jeff before filing.

Windows gfx1151 (warp 1.14 release wheel, ROCm 10.2): wp.record_event(e, external=True) then wp.wait_event(e, external=True) on the same stream inside a ScopedCapture crashes with an access violation 10/10 (in wait_event or later in capture_launch); upstream warp 1.14.0 on V100 passes. Test from AMD-Ecosystem/warp PR #21 commit d03ac24a (test_event_external_same_stream). Linux result pending (gfx942 short checks). jeff 2026-11-25: fix in 1.15 at the earliest; not a 1.14 blocker.

decided.note: 2026-11-25: address in warp 1.15 at the earliest; not a 1.14 blocker ('I want warp 1.14 out. Those problems seem niche.')
